description: Wire sketch-category ops into the SQL CLI path. WritePrimitivesBenchmark.get_queries() and get_queries_by_category() filter out category='sketch', so `benchbox run --benchmark write_primitives --queries sketch_*` fails with 'Invalid query IDs'. The 2026-09-25 approx cloud survey had to drive catalog SQL directly. Add a supported selection path (e.g. --categories sketch, or include sketch ops in --queries) with per-platform skip handling preserved.
